text: Artificial Intelligence, or AI, is the ability of computers to do tasks that usually need human intelligence. Machine learning is a part of AI. It allows computers to learn from data and improve over time without being told exactly what to do. Deep learning is a more advanced type of machine learning. It uses large neural networks to solve difficult problems, like recognising faces or understanding speech. Today, AI is used in many daily activities. For example, it helps suggest videos we might like, translate languages, and power voice assistants on our phones. AI is becoming a normal part of modern life.
